limitations: Incremental published Ardo 5 versus packed candidate; Ardo 4.2 was not rerun.
pnpm 11.25.0 and macOS 27.0.1 differ from the October 4 historical environment.
One diagnostic build per lane; not statistical phase benchmarks.
Native module rendering includes highlighting, JSX emission, maps, and first language loading; it does not isolate tokenization.
Legacy compileJsx metadata and scope compiles are not intercepted by the prototype probe.
Vite bundling windows include native compilation and overlapping plugin waits; do not sum inclusive windows with native totals.
Prepared objects do not cache renders; repeated route transforms still highlight.
